message:
I remember a time when my phone decided to take a break right when I needed it the most. It’s moments like those that remind me how important it is to have a solid plan in place for emergencies. The great folks over at Ready.gov have put together some really useful resources to help us think ahead and prepare for situations where our tech might let us down. 

Having a backup plan can bring a sense of calm, even when things don’t go as expected. How do you keep your family connected during those unpredictable moments?
